mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, type, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, title, content, is_read AS isRead, read_at AS readAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message (user_id, type, target_type, target_id, title, content, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
